Live-contact exception: the new wheel-resolution steps in the CI lint job build this repository's wheel and installs it from the package index into a clean environment, so its only contact is the real index resolving mcp at job time; a recorded replay of that resolution would hide the very drift the job exists to catch, and the job calls no API and uses no runner behaviour that a replay could stand in for. The application build registers one minimal tool, so the tool registration path runs against the resolved SDK too. The changed ratchet files are adequacy receipt data and a baseline list that name no external service, so there is no contact surface to record.
